title: antennaria neglecta var. gaspensis
intro: Antennaria neglecta var. gaspensis, commonly known as Gaspé's Yarrow, is a plant species belonging to the Asteraceae family, characterized by its small, white or pink flowers. The health benefits associated with Gaspé's Yarrow include its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which can be used to treat wounds, skin irritations, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Gaspé's Yarrow include its ability to soothe and calm the mind and body, reducing stress and anxiety, as well as promoting relaxation and sleep. The bioactive constituents present in Gaspé's Yarrow include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
